get_chatgpt_default_headers: get default ChatGPT API headers with access token, account id, and optional session id
get_chatgpt_user_agent: get a ChatGPT user agent string built from originator, litellm version, OS info, and terminal detection
get_chatgpt_session_id: extract a session id from litellm params checking session_id, litellm_session_id, and metadata fields
ensure_chatgpt_session_id: ensure a ChatGPT session id exists by extracting from params or generating a new uuid
get_chatgpt_default_instructions: get the default ChatGPT Codex system instructions with optional environment variable override
